# stb_truetype

`stb_truetype.h` — stb_truetype 1.26 by Sean Barrett (https://github.com/nothings/stb), in the
slightly modified form shipped with Dear ImGui v1.92.9b (compiler and static-analyzer warning
fixes, marked `[DEAR IMGUI]`). Used by `src/core/render/overlay.cpp` to draw the "who is speaking"
captions onto video frames.

License: MIT or public domain (Unlicense), at your choice — see the end of `stb_truetype.h`.
